integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic. A crowded night market on a bridge in monsoon rain, paper lanterns swinging. The camera tracks the moving subject at fast speed. A pangolin sprints between the stalls with a glowing paper lantern in its mouth, knocking over a crate of oranges. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a stall owner in a yellow raincoat vaulting over his counter to give chase. The camera shakes strongly. The owner with a hoarse middle-aged male voice (S1) says: <d>[Cantonese] 站住!</d> [Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to the pangolin leaping off the bridge railing onto a passing boat and vanishing under its canopy, the lantern still glowing. The camera pans right with large amplitude at fast speed.

overall_soundscape: Rain hammers on tarpaulins and oranges bounce across wet planks. A metal gong clatters to the ground.

non_diegetic_music: Fast taiko drums and a driving upright bass at a quick tempo, building in volume.
